sm_top.sm: Yemen's Houthis claimed responsibility for targeting a Saudi position in Aden.
A ballistic missile strike on a military training camp in Yemen killed at least 58 to 73 people.
The UK is sending fighter jets to help Saudi Arabia counter Houthi attacks.
Ukraine launched a large-scale drone attack targeting Russia, setting oil terminals on fire and defying U.S. demands.
South Sudanese President Salva Kiir and officials condemned a Sudanese Armed Forces drone attack on Amiet Market in disputed Abyei.
A tugboat was struck by projectiles off the coast of the UAE, resulting in one injury.
Russian missile and drone attacks across Ukraine killed at least 16 people and injured 69.
The IRGC claimed tankers caught fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz, while US CENTCOM rejected the claims.
Saudi forces intercepted drones following a missile launch toward Riyadh, prompting the coalition to destroy the launcher.
British counterterrorism police rearrested two men in London as part of an investigation into an incident at RAF Fairford.
Ongoing Israeli airstrikes in Gaza have resulted in multiple Palestinian casualties, including deaths and injuries.
Two ships sink near the Strait of Hormuz after being hit by projectiles.
A Houthi missile hit a residential area in Taiz, Yemen, killing two teenage girls.
A paramilitary drone strike near the Ethiopian border in Sudan killed 41 people, according to a rights group.
Drone strikes and interceptions are reported in Khartoum and across Sudan.
Satellite images show Russia built a major new drone attack base in six weeks.
At least 40 civilians were killed in northern Mali following attacks attributed to the Islamic State.
NATO and allied support aircraft continue Steadfast Noon nuclear exercise activity over Italy.
Reports indicated Vladimir Putin directly ordered stepped-up sabotage operations against NATO countries this year.
A Russian drone strike on a residential building in Kyiv killed two people.
Ukraine denies Russian claims of capturing Dobropillia amidst ongoing peace talks.
Russian strikes hit Kyiv and other regions, killing one person and injuring eight.
Drone attacks were reported targeting cargo ships in the Black Sea.
Islamic State-linked militants killed at least 48 civilians in eastern Mali.
Drone strikes on a market in a disputed Sudanese town left more than 150 people dead.
Houthi strike and attack on a camp and the presidential palace in Yemen, resulting in casualties including reported deaths and injuries.
Russian drone and missile strikes hit transport infrastructure and a substation in Kyiv.
The Pentagon deployed the USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier strike group and Marines to West Asia amid rising tensions with Iran.
UNICEF reported that over 340 children have been killed in Gaza since the ceasefire.
Persisting shipping risks in the Strait of Hormuz drive up oil prices.
Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 150 drones used by Russia in an overnight attack.
Iran's navy claims US forces struck the Konarak naval base, wounding two soldiers, following reports of blasts in the area.
Overnight Russian strikes hit residential buildings and other locations in Ukraine, killing four people.
A funeral is held in Yemen's Shabwa for security personnel killed in a Houthi missile attack.
Houthis strike Saudi-led coalition targets after Saudi airstrikes across Yemen killed eight fishermen.
A drone strike damaged eight of twelve storage tanks at the Novoshakhtinsk Oil Products Plant.
The Ukrainian Air Force reported that Russian forces launched 186 drones and Iskander-K cruise missiles overnight.
Russian missile and drone attacks across Ukraine killed at least 9 people and wounded 45, including a deadly strike in Kyiv.
Russian air defense intercepted and destroyed 373 Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions and the Black Sea.
A Russian drone strike hits a park in Kharkiv Oblast, killing six people.
